description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle) has been ruled out for the Jaguars' game against the Titans on Sunday.
items.impact: With Tuten out, the Jags will lean on Chris Rodriguez against the Titans. Rodriguez should be a decent RB2 option based on volume. Tuten will try to find his way back on the field next week.
items.title: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle) ruled out against Titans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Isaiah Rodgers Sr. has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Falcons.
items.impact: Rodgers remains week-to-week with a quad injury.
items.title: Isaiah Rodgers Sr. (quad) ruled out for Week 12

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Christian Darrisaw has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Falcons.
items.impact: Darrisaw will remain sidelined with a shoulder injury for the Vikings.
items.title: Christian Darrisaw (shoulder) ruled out for Week 12

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Juwan Johnson (hamstring/wrist) has been ruled out for Week 12 for the New Orleans Saints against the Cincinnati Bengals according to Ross Jackson.
items.impact: Johnson will not suit up after being unable to practice, with Noah Fant and Oscar Delp in line for increased snaps against the Bengals for head coach Kellen Moore Sunday.
items.title: Juwan Johnson (hamstring/wrist) ruled out for Week 12

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Jordan Addison (thumb) has been ruled out for Sunday's contest between the Minnesota Vikings and Atlanta Falcons according to Ben Goessling.
items.impact: Addison continues to work back from a thumb injury for head coach Kevin O'Connell, with Tai Felton, Jauan Jennings, and Myles Price to see increased snaps behind WR1 Justin Jefferson against the Falcons.
items.title: Jordan Addison (thumb) ruled out for Week 12

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Will Mallory has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Giants.
items.impact: Mallory will remain sidelined with a hamstring injury.
items.title: Will Mallory (hamstring) ruled out for Week 12

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jerry Tillery has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Giants.
items.impact: Tillery will be sidelined with a calf injury.
items.title: Jerry Tillery (calf) ruled out for Week 12

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jalen Travis has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Giants.
items.impact: Travis will be sidelined with a knee injury.
items.title: Jalen Travis (knee) ruled out for Week 12

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Seth McGowan has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Giants.
items.impact: McGowan is slated to miss some time with his hamstring injury.
items.title: Seth McGowan (hamstring) ruled out for Week 12

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Charvarius Ward Sr. has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Giants.
items.impact: Ward will miss another game with a knee injury.
items.title: Charvarius Ward Sr. (knee) ruled out for Week 12

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Dalton Risner has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Saints.
items.impact: Risner will remain sidelined for the Bengals. He is considered day-to-day.
items.title: Dalton Risner (knee) ruled out for Week 12

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Brandon Aiyuk will not be elevated for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
items.impact: Aiyuk signed with the Commanders practice squad this week. He'll have a chance to make his debut with Washington next week.
items.title: Brandon Aiyuk will not be elevated for Week 12

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Woody Marks has cleared concussion protocol and will play on Sunday against the Ravens.
items.impact: Marks will return on Sunday. It'll likely continue to be a committee between him and David Montgomery.
items.title: Woody Marks clears concussion protocol, will play Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Romeo Doubs is not expected to return for Sunday's game against the Chargers.
items.impact: Doubs was able to return to a limited practice this week. He'll have a chance to return next week.
items.title: Romeo Doubs (shoulder) unlikely to play in Week 12

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Carlton Davis III has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chargers.
items.impact: Davis will remain sidelined with a knee injury.
items.title: Carlton Davis III (knee) ruled out for Week 12

items.title: Tonka Hemingway (stinger) not at practice Friday

items.desc: Tim Keenan III was not seen at practice on Friday.

items.title: Tim Keenan III (knee) not seen at practice Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Adam Butler was not seen at practice on Friday.

items.title: Adam Butler (concussion) not at practice Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Amik Robertson has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Commanders.
items.impact: Commanders head coach said there's no long-term concern "yet" for Robertson.
items.title: Amik Robertson ruled out for Week 12

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Brock Bowers (ankle) was not seen practicing for the Las Vegas Raiders Friday according to Ryan McFadden.
items.impact: Bowers was unable to reach the practice field after limited sessions Wednesday and Thursday, putting the dynamic tight end's availability in question. Michael Mayer would be in line for TE1 snaps if Bowers is unable to suit up against the Browns Sunday night.
items.title: Brock Bowers (ankle) not practicing Friday

items.title: Billy Bowman Jr. (hamstring) ruled out for Week 12

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Tyler Badie (thumb) is active for Week 12 for the Denver Broncos against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Badie will suit up after being activated from injured reserve earlier in the week, providing head coach Sean Payton with a change of pace option behind RB1 Jonah Coleman against the Steelers Friday.
items.title: Tyler Badie (thumb) active for Week 12

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Matthew Bergeron has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Vikings.

items.desc: Cole Holcomb has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Broncos.
items.impact: Holcomb suffered a heel injury in last week's loss to the Eagles. He will be sidelined after being listed as questionable.
items.title: Cole Holcomb (heel) ruled out for Week 12
